regime_context: The US thematic detector shows a broad rotation with Memory, HBM & Storage leading but fading (low breadth, mixed trend, negative short-term return). Cybersecurity is a durable but crowded challenger. The absolute trend gate, the only validated edge, is active and has historically helped cap drawdowns. Given poor track record (2/5 hits, 0.2 directional accuracy), all calls default to low conviction.
emerging_watch: Memory, HBM & Storage leadership fade: if r10 remains negative and breadth does not expand above 0.2 within 10 trading days, the theme is likely to be overtaken.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The leading theme is fading: durability bar only 0.46, breadth zero, Hurst mixed, and the 10-day return is negative (-12.2%). Although eligible under the trend gate, the deterioration suggests it will struggle to sustain outperformance versus the benchmark. A marginal underweight, not a short.
theses.dissent: Memory demand could rebound if AI server DRAM prices spike on new product cycles, and the trend gate remains true, indicating no absolute breakdown yet.

falsifier.text: Memory's 10-day return turns positive and breadth rises above 0.3 within two weeks.

theses.subject: Energy (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Energy exhibits a durable uptrend (durability 0.75, Hurst trend, breadth 0.857) and is not crowded. As AI-related themes show fading leadership and macro uncertainty is high (unscheduled surprise share 1.0), steady energy flows may benefit from rotation into value/cyclical narratives, provided the absolute trend persists.
theses.dissent: Energy could reverse if oil prices drop sharply on recession fears or if the broadening rotation fails to materialize, with capital returning to the crowded but durable Cybersecurity theme.

falsifier.text: Energy's absolute trend gate flips to ineligible (close below its trend threshold) or breadth collapses below 0.5.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
